name: Path Dimension of Warmuth's $C_5$ Class
proof: On the coordinate set $\{0,1,2,4\}$, the ordering $0,1,2,4$ and starting trace $0110$ give a full path through five realized traces.  A length-five path would have to use the full five-coordinate projection; enumerating its $5!$ coordinate orderings and starting traces finds no full path of length five.  Hence the path dimension is four.
